decks.notes: This deck revolves around a fast and aggressive strategy centered on the commander, Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis. The key concept is to quickly fill up the graveyard with a variety of creatures and utilize cards like Faithless Looting, Stitcher's Supplier, and Glowspore Shaman to enable Hogaak's ability to be cast easily. The deck includes a mix of low-cost creatures, removal spells, and graveyard recursion to maintain pressure on the opponent. By efficiently utilizing the graveyard as a resource, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push.

This deck is focused on utilizing artifacts to generate a token army of Thopters while controlling the board. The commander, Sai, Master Thopterist, allows for easy generation of Thopter tokens whenever an artifact enters the battlefield. The deck includes a variety of mana rocks, card draw spells, and interaction to help maintain tempo and disrupt opponents' strategies. It also features cards like Urza, Lord High Artificer and Tezzeret the Seeker to further enhance artifact synergy and provide powerful win conditions. By overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of flying creatures and utilizing powerful artifacts, this deck aims to quickly establish dominance on the battlefield and secure a victory in the 1 vs 1 format.

The focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. With Balmor, Battlemage Captain as the commander, the deck includes a mix of efficient creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, along with powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast. By deploying a steady stream of threats and burning the opponent's life total with direct damage, this deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of counter spells and disruptive creatures like Loyal Apprentice adds some versatility to the aggressive game plan, allowing the deck to interact with the opponent's strategy while still applying pressure.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures and then use various graveyard synergies to bring them back onto the battlefield for aggressive plays. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of threats, utilizing cards like Reanimate, Gravecrawler, and Vengevine to maintain board presence and apply pressure. Additionally, the deck includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to disrupt the opponent's game plan while continuing to advance its own board state. By efficiently utilizing the graveyard and combining it with aggressive creatures, this deck aims to quickly close out games in a 1 vs 1 format.

The deck revolves around reanimating powerful creatures and combo pieces to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It utilizes a mix of reanimation spells like Animate Dead, Dance of the Dead, and Reanimate, as well as powerful creatures like Griselbrand, Elesh Norn, and Emrakul, the Promised End. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's hand and stall their game plan. The mana base consists of various lands to ensure consistency in casting spells and abilities. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and close out the game with overwhelming threats.

The essential strategy of this deck is centered around aggressive play, utilizing cards that deal direct damage to the opponent while putting pressure on them with fast creatures. By including a variety of burn spells, aggressive creatures, and mana denial effects, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero before they can stabilize. The commander, Feldon, Ronom Excavator, provides additional value by recurring creatures from the graveyard, allowing for additional threats to be constantly presented. The deck also includes a mix of hasty creatures and efficient removal spells to ensure that the opponent is constantly on the back foot, struggling to keep up with the relentless assault.

The Golos, Tireless Pilgrim control deck focuses on utilizing a versatile toolbox of cards to control the game, disrupt opponents' strategies, and generate value through various synergies. It includes a mix of removal spells, mana dorks, ramp spells, versatile creatures, and powerful planeswalkers to stay ahead on board presence and card advantage. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence while disrupting opponents with targeted removal, countermagic, and other disruptive cards. Golos acts as a versatile commander, providing card advantage and access to powerful spells from outside the main deck. By managing resources efficiently and controlling the game, the deck can outvalue opponents and secure victory.

This deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive strategy utilizing two partner commanders, Cultist of the Absolute and Gut, True Soul Zealot. The deck is filled with low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly bring down the opponent's life total. The mana base includes a mix of dual lands and fetch lands to ensure consistent mana production. Key cards like Rabid Battery and Robber of the Rich provide additional damage and card advantage. With a mix of efficient creatures, removal spells, and direct damage, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a flurry of early threats while maintaining pressure throughout the game. By combining the speed and power of both commanders, this deck seeks to secure victory before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck revolves around using Aminatou's abilities to control the game by manipulating the top of the library, reanimating creatures, and disrupting opponents' strategies. It includes powerful cards like Agent of Treachery and Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite to gain control of the battlefield, alongside various tutors and counterspells to ensure dominance. The deck aims to maintain a strong presence on the board while disrupting opponents' plans through a combination of removal, card advantage, and graveyard recursion. By carefully managing resources and predicting opponents' moves, this Control deck seeks to outmaneuver the competition and emerge victorious in the 1 vs 1 Duel Commander format.

This aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a fast and efficient red burn strategy. Utilizing cards that deal direct damage like Lightning Bolt, Searing Blaze, and Flame Javelin, the deck aims to chip away at the opponent's life total quickly. Cards like Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Seasoned Pyromancer provide card advantage and board presence, while cards like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear offer aggressive early game attackers. The deck also includes cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon to disrupt opponent's mana bases. By pressuring the opponent and efficiently using burn spells, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize or mount a defense.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells. Ghyrson Starn, Kelermorph acts as the commander and provides additional support for the aggressive strategy. The deck includes a variety of low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Young Pyromancer, and Soul-Scar Mage, coupled with efficient burn spells such as Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Fiery Confluence to apply pressure and deal direct damage. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Counterspell, Force of Will, and Spell Snare to protect its own threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the key strategy is to establish early board presence, control the opponent's threats, and finish the game with direct damage.

The deck's focus is on building a powerful and aggressive board presence with a strong emphasis on utilizing efficient creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Isamaru, Hound of Konda as the commander and key creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Elite Spellbinder, the deck aims to control the board while applying pressure to the opponent. The inclusion of removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and unexpected Absent helps to deal with threats, while cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Umezawa's Jitte provide powerful equipment options to enhance the deck's overall strategy. With a strong emphasis on tempo and disruption, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's plays through counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures like Drannith Magistrate and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like True-Name Nemesis and Skyclave Apparition to chip away at their life total. The deck also has a strong card advantage engine with cards like Dark Confidant, Brazen Borrower, and Teferi, Time Raveler to outvalue the opponent. The mana base is optimized to support the deck's color requirements and allow for smooth mana development. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure while keeping the opponent off balance with disruption and card advantage.

The deck focuses on a control strategy with a variety of removal, counter spells, and card advantage. The commanders provide flexibility and additional card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while slowly building up to a win condition. It includes a mix of efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Fatal Push, alongside powerful card draw and filtering like Brainstorm and Ponder. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and includes dual lands and fetch lands. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through disruption and card advantage, ultimately leading to a win through powerful threats like Baleful Strix and Celestial Colonnade.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies with two partner commanders, Bruse Tarl and Yoshimaru. The deck includes a mix of efficient creatures and removal spells to put pressure on the opponent. The goal is to establish a fast board presence and attack relentlessly, utilizing cards like Anafenza, King of Oreskos, Embercleave, and Skullclamp to maximize damage output. The mana base is optimized for consistent casting of spells, with a mix of fetch lands, dual lands, and powerful utility lands like Eiganjo Castle and Urza's Saga. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and potent combat tricks to secure a quick victory in one-on-one matches.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and combat tricks to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The commanders, Bruse Tarl and Yoshimaru, provide efficient support and synergies to enhance the aggro strategy. The deck includes powerful creatures like Anafenza, Kari Zev, and Luminarch Aspirant, as well as removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Lightning Bolt. It also features equipment like Embercleave and Skullclamp to boost the creatures' effectiveness in combat. The land base is optimized for consistency and mana fixing, with options like Caves of Chaos Adventurer and Eiganjo Castle. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain aggression throughout the game to secure victory.
